只显示服务端白名单内的缓存前缀，最多加载 500 个键。: Only server-allowed cache prefixes are shown, with up to 500 keys.
标准 5 字段：分钟 小时 日 月 周；或 @every 5m。不支持秒字段。: Standard 5 fields: minute, hour, day, month, weekday; or @every 5m. Seconds are not supported.
请输入 5 字段 cron 或 @every 时间间隔: Enter a five-field cron or @every interval
取消请求已发送，请刷新确认最终状态。: Cancellation requested. Refresh to confirm the final state.
实时观察任务流转，安全处理积压、失败与运行中的任务。: Monitor task flow and safely handle backlogs, failures, and active work.
待处理延迟 {seconds} 秒 · 当前队列 {count} 个任务: Pending latency {seconds}s · {count} tasks in this queue
任务身份与参数受到保护: Task identities and parameters are protected
仅管理当前部署的队列。内部导出参数完全隐藏，任务重试会重新验证原用户权限；已完成: Only this deployment’s queues are managed. Internal export parameters are hidden. Retries revalidate the original user’s permissions; completed durable operations are never repeated.
内部任务参数与身份信息已隐藏: Internal parameters and identity are hidden
执行失败，详细原因请查看有权限的业务日志: Execution failed. View authorized business logs for details.
队列操作无法自动撤销；不会修改任务参数、导出身份或持久完成记录。: Queue actions cannot be automatically undone. Task parameters, export identity, and durable completion records remain protected.
任务将立即进入待处理队列，重新执行原处理器；异步导出会重新验证原发起人的当前权限: The task will immediately enter the pending queue and rerun its original handler. Async exports revalidate the initiator’s current permissions.
取消为尽力请求，worker 会取消任务上下文并停止后续重试；已提交的业务结果不: Cancellation is best effort. The worker cancels the task context and stops further retries. Committed results remain. Refresh to confirm the final state.
永久删除 Redis 中的任务与结果。持久完成标记仍会保留，防止业务重复执行。: Permanently delete the task and result from Redis. Durable completion markers remain to prevent duplicate operations.
暂停只阻止领取新任务，运行中的任务继续执行。可通过恢复队列处理继续消费。: Pausing stops workers from taking new tasks. Active tasks continue. Resume the queue to continue processing.
只能管理当前部署的 critical、default 或 low 队列: Only this deployment’s critical, default, or low queues can be managed
任务状态必须为 pending、active、scheduled、retry、a: Task state must be pending, active, scheduled, retry, archived, or completed
页码超出允许范围: Page number exceeds the allowed range
任务编号必填，最多 128 字节: Task ID is required and must be at most 128 bytes
当前队列中不存在该任务: Task does not exist in this queue
执行前必须提供预览时的 expectedState: Provide the expectedState from the preview before execution
任务状态已变化，请刷新后重新预览: Task state changed. Refresh and preview again
当前任务状态不支持此操作，已完成的持久任务不会重新执行: This action is unavailable in the current state. Completed durable tasks cannot run again
任务状态可能已变化，请刷新后重试: Task state may have changed. Refresh and retry
